evals.name: conftest-and-patterns-design
evals.prompt: I'm starting backend/tests/conftest.py for App unit tests. Show me the shared fixtures I need (mock_anthropic_stream, mock_data_reader, session_factory, tool registry isolation), the AsyncMock pattern for streaming providers, how to manually construct tool_use content blocks for testing the agent loop, and the pytest markers I should define. Also explain what's out of scope for the baseline testing setup.

assertions.text: Answer defines all 4 core fixtures explicitly by name — mock_anthropic_stream, mock_data_reader, session_factory, and a tool-registry isolation fixture — with code or clear signatures, not just a narrative list
Answer marks the tool-registry isolation fixture (and/or a provider-cache reset fixture) as autouse=True and explains that process-state fixtures MUST be autouse to prevent silent test pollution
Answer shows the AsyncMock streaming pattern as a factory that takes a list of scripted ProviderEvent dicts and yields them via an async generator, not a single return_value mock

Answer includes a concrete example of manually constructing tool_use content blocks (tool_use_start/delta/end sequence) to drive the agent loop without a real LLM call, tied to registering a stub Tool in ToolRegistry
Answer defines exactly 4 pytest markers by name — unit, integration, slow, phase2b — in a pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options] markers list with descriptions
Answer explicitly states that VCR cassette / record-replay infrastructure is documented in Chapter B (or equivalent), instead of silently including a VCR recipe in the base setup
Answer does not reference any retired internal identifiers (Phase / AD-### / harness porter labels).
